title: Vibrant Pink Ethiopian Injera Bake
description: A unique and flavorful Ethiopian dish featuring a fermented injera base, colored with pink food coloring and baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven, this nut-free friendly dish is perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: wood-fired-baked vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as zucchini, bell peppers, and onions

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the teff flour, water, pink food coloring, yeast, salt, and sugar, and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let the mixture ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Pour the fermented injera batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Add the wood-fired-baked vegetables on top of the injera batter.
Bake the injera for 25 minutes, or until it is set and slightly puffed.
Remove the injera from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the vibrant pink Ethiopian injera bake warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
